judged_text: The new raw_html cook method makes Post#cook return the raw string unsanitized, and both ingest paths feed untrusted remote HTML into it: PollFeed stores CGI.unescapeHTML(feed content) with no sanitize/readability pass at all, and the embed view renders it with `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb:19). Script or event-handler markup in any item of the configured feed (content fully attacker-controlled if the feed is third-party) is stored as cooked HTML and executes as stored XSS for readers of the topic and of the embedded comments iframe; the normal cooking pipeline whose sanitization this relies on is explicitly skipped.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and makes `Post#cook` return `raw` directly when `cook_method` is `raw_html` (`app/models/post.rb`), explicitly skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. Both ingestion paths in this diff can feed remote HTML into such posts: `Jobs::PollFeed` uses `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)` and takes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` with no sanitization (`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`), then `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb`). The embed view then renders `raw post.cooked` (`app/views/embed/best.html.erb`), so attacker-controlled markup (e.g., `<script>` or event handlers) can be stored and executed. The readability-based path restricts tags/attrs, but the feed path does not, matching the finding.
